GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Held up for clear running from the 150m and went to the line not fully tested. Rider  questioned regarding his riding near the 200m and if there was an opportunity to improve to the outside of Governor King, they explained a run had developed between runners, however, as a runner was always in advance of him and laying in, he was unable to improve and as a result went to the line not fully tested.
